# The palette lists the sessions liberttyd keeps that no window shows. It
# asks liberttyd off the main thread (one busy or stuck would hold the
# palette up): their rows come with the answer. @BIN@ is the app, its CLI too.
shell:@BIN@ +new-session -e 'sleep 600' > /dev/null
wait:0.5
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.6
type:show session
wait:0.4
expect-palette:Show Session
expect-palette-selected:Show Session
# Return shows it in a tab here.
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-tab-count:2
# Shown now: no longer listed.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.6
type:show session
wait:0.4
expect-palette-not:Show Session
key:escape
wait:0.3
